verdict.rationale: Langfuse's docs say it can receive traces on a dedicated OTLP endpoint (`/api/public/otel`) and list OpenTelemetry as a first-class way to capture traces alongside its native SDKs. That means developers can send traces in standard OTLP instead of only using a proprietary format. Missing for 10: details on supported OTLP transports and semantic-convention mapping, any evidence of exporting traces out of Langfuse over OTLP, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the OTLP ingestion works.
